title: Raster Hierarchy Integration
description: Integrate raster workbench hierarchy with layer create, delete, reorder, and property updates in details panel.
summary: Integrated raster workbench and details panels with full layer management. Hierarchy tab now shows nested layers (fixed items vs children), add-layer toolbar rows, drag-and-drop reorder, catalogue drops, visibility toggles, and context-menu duplicate/delete/add-mask. Added Catalogue tab (new layer types, blend modes, filters). Details tab uses declarative inspector fields for name, opacity, blend, visibility, dimensions, and adjustment kind plus duplicate/delete actions. Extended core edit ops for duplicate, mask, size, adjustment kind, filter append, and layer location helpers.
